about.title: Who is Sukhrobjon Rikhsiboev?
about.p1: Sukhrobjon Rikhsiboev is an entrepreneur, digital strategist, and the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of ZAMINAT.eco, based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
about.p2: Combining approximately six years of operational and digital strategy leadership in a U.S.-based automotive dealership environment with a formal degree in Business Administration from Amity University Tashkent (2024), Sukhrobjon focuses on leveraging artificial intelligence, process engineering, and circular economy principles to solve urban environmental challenges in Central Asia.
about.p3: Under his leadership, ZAMINAT has evolved from an initial concept into a structured early-stage ClimateTech venture with working AI prototypes, registered intellectual property, and active community participation initiatives.

building.title: Building ZAMINAT.eco
building.subtitle: AI-Powered Waste-to-Life Vision & Circular Architecture
building.p1: ZAMINAT was conceived to bridge the gap between digital technology and physical circular material recovery in Uzbekistan. The core 'Waste-to-Life' paradigm focuses on transforming secondary materials—primarily recycled plastics and discarded automotive rubber/tires—into long-lasting urban infrastructure, modular tiles, street furniture, and eco-products.
building.digitalMvpDesc: ZAMINAT's digital ecosystem currently operates with verified, functional software tools:
building.ecoscan: EcoScan AI: A multi-modal computer vision tool that classifies recyclable waste fractions and guides proper disposal in real time.
building.zami: Zami AI Agent: An intelligent conversational eco-coach assisting citizens with sorting instructions, recycling guidelines, and sustainability tips.
building.architecturesDesc: The venture has established comprehensive architectures for EcoApp (a gamified citizen action and reward platform) and EcoKids (an interactive ecological curriculum for younger generations).
building.physicalRoadmapNote: Data Transparency Notice: ZAMINAT's current production release is an early-stage digital MVP. Physical municipal collection networks and industrial manufacturing facilities are planned expansion stages on the company's long-term infrastructure roadmap.

background.title: Professional Background
background.p1: Prior to founding ZAMINAT, Sukhrobjon accumulated approximately six years of intensive professional experience within a high-tempo U.S.-based automotive dealership environment.
background.p2: His responsibilities encompassed cross-functional leadership across digital marketing, technical search engine optimization (SEO), workflow automation using AI tools, business analytics, cybersecurity coordination, IT infrastructure integration, procurement, and process optimization.
background.p3: This operational background provides ZAMINAT with strong discipline in customer lifecycle management, conversion architecture, operational efficiency, and data-backed decision-making.

education.title: Education & Academic Foundation
education.desc: Curriculum focused on strategic management, international business operations, organizational leadership, and digital technology integration.

mission.title: Mission for Uzbekistan
mission.p1: Sukhrobjon's mission is centered on pragmatic, technology-driven sustainability for Uzbekistan.
mission.p2: Rather than relying on abstract rhetoric, ZAMINAT focuses on measurable improvements: encouraging cleaner urban environments, educating youth on environmental stewardship, developing circular recovery channels for high-volume waste streams, and building transparent digital tools that make ecological action accessible to every citizen.
mission.quote: Sustainable change in Uzbekistan will not come from theory alone—it requires disciplined execution, intuitive digital tools, and genuine community participation.
